name: Wo de Maoniang Lianren
source:
Zirui, who lives alone, takes in a dying black cat. One rainy night the black cat suddenly 'bad-mouthed' Zirui.
The next day the black cat disappears, and at the same time, a cat lady appears in Zirui's bed who resembles the black cat ......
A clingy-looking cat lady and a seemingly heartless master.
Will the nonsensical and joyful routine change the withdrawn Zirui?
Hilarious comedy on!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2018640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
独居的子睿收养了一只垂死的黑猫。一个雨夜，黑猫突然“说坏话”子瑞。
第二天，黑猫消失了，与此同时，子睿的床上出现了一位酷似黑猫的猫娘……
看似粘人的猫女，看似无情的主人。
无厘头又欢乐的日常会改变性格孤僻的子睿吗？
爆笑喜剧上演！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2018640/]Steam[/url]]
